name: Recipes by Station
body:
Chef de Partie Station Boucher | Entremetier | Friturier | Garde Manger | Grillardin | Line Cook | Patissier | Poissonier | Rotisseur | Roundsman | Saucier

Profiles include bitter (B), salty (S), sour (O), spicy (P), sweet (W), temperature (T), texture (X), and umami (U). Some recipes are learned by different stations at higher levels.

Order of Presentation: The recipes are listed in alphabetical order by name, except when a spell’s name begins with a descriptor such as “simple,” in which case it is alphabetized under the second word of the spell name.
